summary: From fiscal 2007 to 2025, CENCORA, INC. reported $2,951.8 billion of revenue and $33.7 billion of free cash flow. Stock pay was $1.2 billion, which leaves $32.5 billion of owner cash: 1.1% of revenue.
Owner cash was under 3.0% of revenue in 19 of 19 years.
In the 12 months to 2026-06-30 it was 1.2% of revenue.
